package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"lab-transport/internal/auth"
	"lab-transport/internal/config"
	"lab-transport/internal/db"
	"lab-transport/internal/handlers"
	"lab-transport/internal/routing"
	"lab-transport/internal/services"
)

func main() {
	cfg := config.Load()

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	database, err := db.Connect(ctx, cfg)
	cancel()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Failed to connect to database: %v", err)
	}
	defer database.Close()

	// Initialize Services
	authSvc := auth.NewAuthService(database)
	auditSvc := services.NewAuditService(database)
	eventSvc := services.NewEventService(database)
	userSvc := services.NewUserService(database, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	rEngine := routing.NewServiceabilityEngine(database)
	fairness := services.FairnessEngineNew(database, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	locSvc := services.NewLocationService(database, rEngine, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	sampleSvc := services.NewSampleService(database, rEngine, fairness, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	journeySvc := services.NewJourneyService(database, rEngine, fairness, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	opSvc := services.NewOperationsService(database, rEngine)

	// Compute initial snapshot
	ctxSnap, cancelSnap := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	_ = rEngine.RecomputeSnapshot(ctxSnap)
	cancelSnap()

	// Ensure Initial Admin
	adminUser := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	adminPass := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
	if adminUser == "" {
		adminUser = "admin"
	}
	if adminPass == "" {
		adminPass = "Admin123!"
	}
	ctxAdmin, cancelAdmin := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	_ = authSvc.EnsureInitialAdmin(ctxAdmin, adminUser, adminPass)
	cancelAdmin()

	apiHandler := handlers.NewAPIHandler(
		database, authSvc, auditSvc, eventSvc, userSvc, locSvc, sampleSvc, journeySvc, opSvc, rEngine, fairness,
	)

	r := mux.NewRouter()

	// Global CORS middleware
	r.Use(corsMiddleware)

	// Readiness check (no auth)
	r.HandleFunc("/ready", apiHandler.ReadyHandler).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/ready", apiHandler.ReadyHandler).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")

	// Auth & Serviceability Check (no session auth required)
	r.HandleFunc("/api/authenticate-user", apiHandler.AuthenticateUser).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/check-serviceability", apiHandler.CheckServiceability).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/read-serviceability-snapshot", apiHandler.ReadServiceabilitySnapshot).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/list-sample-types", apiHandler.ListSampleTypes).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/get-sample-type/{sampleTypeId}", apiHandler.GetSampleType).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/list-locations", apiHandler.ListLocations).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/get-location/{locationId}", apiHandler.GetLocation).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/list-connections", apiHandler.ListConnections).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/get-connection/{connectionId}", apiHandler.GetConnection).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/events", apiHandler.EventsSSE).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")

	// Protected routes subrouter
	api := r.PathPrefix("/api").Subrouter()
	api.Use(authSvc.AuthMiddleware)

	api.HandleFunc("/select-active-role", apiHandler.SelectActiveRole).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/read-user/{userId}", apiHandler.ReadUser).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/create-user", apiHandler.CreateUser).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-user-access", apiHandler.UpdateUserAccess).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-worker-availability", apiHandler.SetWorkerAvailability).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/record-worker-location", apiHandler.RecordWorkerLocation).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/create-location", apiHandler.CreateLocation).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-location", apiHandler.UpdateLocation).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-location-status", apiHandler.SetLocationStatus).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-location-function-status", apiHandler.SetLocationFunctionStatus).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/create-connection", apiHandler.CreateConnection).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-connection-status", apiHandler.SetConnectionStatus).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/configure-capacity", apiHandler.ConfigureCapacity).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/configure-laboratory-acceptance", apiHandler.ConfigureLaboratoryAcceptance).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/create-sample-type", apiHandler.CreateSampleType).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-sample-type", apiHandler.UpdateSampleType).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/create-collection-request", apiHandler.CreateCollectionRequest).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/ingest-presealed-sample", apiHandler.IngestPresealedSample).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/collect-and-seal-sample", apiHandler.CollectAndSealSample).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/initiate-handoff", apiHandler.InitiateHandoff).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/confirm-handoff", apiHandler.ConfirmHandoff).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/record-handling-checkpoint", apiHandler.RecordHandlingCheckpoint).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/confirm-laboratory-receipt", apiHandler.ConfirmLaboratoryReceipt).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/record-laboratory-exception", apiHandler.RecordLaboratoryException).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/read-sample-lifecycle", apiHandler.ReadSampleLifecycle).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/read-journey-plan", apiHandler.ReadJourneyPlan).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/accept-assignment", apiHandler.AcceptAssignment).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/decline-assignment", apiHandler.DeclineAssignment).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-assignment-progress", apiHandler.UpdateAssignmentProgress).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/edit-active-plan", apiHandler.EditActivePlan).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/reroute-journey", apiHandler.RerouteJourney).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/cancel-journey", apiHandler.CancelJourney).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/merge-journeys", apiHandler.MergeJourneys).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/split-journey", apiHandler.SplitJourney).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/report-disruption", apiHandler.ReportDisruption).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/list-role-work", apiHandler.ListRoleWork).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/read-operations-state", apiHandler.ReadOperationsState).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/search-audit-trail", apiHandler.SearchAuditTrail).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	// Map assets handler (/map-assets/*)
	mapAssetsDir := "/map-assets"
	if _, err := os.Stat(mapAssetsDir); err == nil {
		r.PathPrefix("/map-assets/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/map-assets/", http.FileServer(http.Dir(mapAssetsDir))))
	}

	// Frontend SPA static file server
	frontendDist := "/workspace/frontend/dist"
	r.PathPrefix("/").Handler(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(req.URL.Path, "/api") || req.URL.Path == "/ready" || strings.HasPrefix(req.URL.Path, "/map-assets") {
			http.NotFound(w, req)
			return
		}

		path := filepath.Join(frontendDist, filepath.Clean(req.URL.Path))
		if stat, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil && !stat.IsDir() {
			http.ServeFile(w, req, path)
			return
		}
		// Fallback to index.html for SPA client-side routing
		http.ServeFile(w, req, filepath.Join(frontendDist, "index.html"))
	}))

	port := os.Getenv("PORT")
	if port == "" {
		port = "8080"
	}
	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:         ":" + port,
		Handler:      r,
		ReadTimeout:  30 * time.Second,
		WriteTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
	}

	go func() {
		log.Printf("Server listening on http://127.0.0.1:%s", port)
		if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			log.Fatalf("HTTP server error: %v", err)
		}
	}()

	// Graceful shutdown
	quit := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(quit, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	<-quit

	log.Println("Shutting down server gracefully...")
	ctxShut, cancelShut := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancelShut()
	_ = server.Shutdown(ctxShut)
	log.Println("Server exited")
}

func corsMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Authorization, X-Requested-With, Idempotency-Key")

		if r.Method == "OPTIONS" {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			return
		}

		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

	// Frontend SPA static file server
	frontendDist := "/workspace/frontend/dist"
	r.PathPrefix("/").Handler(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {

			http.NotFound(w, req)
			return
		}

		path := filepath.Join(frontendDist, filepath.Clean(req.URL.Path))
		if stat, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil && !stat.IsDir() {
			http.ServeFile(w, req, path)
			return
		}
		// Fallback to index.html for SPA client-side routing

		}

	<-quit

	ctxShut, cancelShut := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancelShut()
	_ = server.Shutdown(ctxShut)
	log.Println("Server exited")

func corsMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Authorization, X-Requested-With, Idempotency-Key")

		if r.Method == "OPTIONS" {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			return
		}

		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

    print("Login:", res.status_code, res.json())
    assert res.status_code == 200
    token = res.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

    print("Sample types:", res.status_code, len(res.json()["data"]))
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert len(res.json()["data"]) >= 4

    res = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/list-locations", headers=headers)
    print("Locations:", res.status_code, len(res.json()["data"]))

        "originLatitude": 12.9716,
        "originLongitude": 77.5946,
        "originAddress": "123 MG Road, Bangalore",
        "sampleType": "amber",
        "earliestCollection": now.isoformat(),
        "latestCollection": (now + datetime.timedelta(hours=2)).isoformat(),
        "deliveryDeadline": (now + datetime.timedelta(hours=6)).isoformat(),
        "notes": "Fragile test sample"
    }

    assert res.status_code == 201

    request_id = res.json()["data"]["requestId"]
    journey_id = res.json()["data"]["journeyId"]

    print("Read sample trace:", res.status_code, res.json()["data"]["currentStatus"])
    assert res.status_code == 200

    # 7. Switch to administrator and read operations state
    res = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/select-active-role", json={"role": "administrator"}, headers=headers)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    res = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/read-operations-state", json={}, headers=headers)
    print("Operations state:", res.status_code, len(res.json()["data"]["samples"]), "samples,", len(res.json()["data"]["journeys"]), "journeys")
    assert res.status_code == 200

    # 8. List role work
    res = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/list-role-work", json={"includeCompleted": True}, headers=headers)
    print("List role work:", res.status_code, len(res.json()["data"]["activeWork"]), "active items")
    assert res.status_code == 200

    print("All basic API tests passed successfully!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_api()

    84	func HaversineDistanceKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 float64) float64 {
    85		const earthRadiusKm = 6371.0
    86	
    87		dLat := (lat2 - lat1) * (math.Pi / 180.0)
    88		dLon := (lon2 - lon1) * (math.Pi / 180.0)
    89	
    90		rLat1 := lat1 * (math.Pi / 180.0)
    91		rLat2 := lat2 * (math.Pi / 180.0)
    92	
    93		a := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) +
    94			math.Sin(dLon/2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)*math.Cos(rLat1)*math.Cos(rLat2)
    95		c := 2 * math.Atan2(math.Sqrt(a), math.Sqrt(1-a))
    96	
    97		return earthRadiusKm * c
    98	}

     1	# Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery System
     2	
     3	Clinical samples may start at a patient’s home, a clinic, or a collection point and must reach a suitable laboratory before their delivery deadline.
     4	
     5	Home samples must be collected and sealed by a certified collection professional before they can enter the transport network. Once sealed, a sample may pass through relay couriers, collection centres and hubs before reaching the laboratory.
     6	
     7	Dispatchers currently coordinate much of this work through calls, chat groups, and spreadsheets. This makes it difficult to track custody, use available capacity, assign work fairly, combine compatible samples, and recover when part of the network becomes unavailable.
     8	
     9	Build a web application that manages this entire process, from the initial serviceability check through laboratory receipt.
    10	
    11	## Users and responsibilities
    12	
    13	Use role-based access control for both actions and data: each user may perform actions and see data only as permitted by the role or roles they currently hold.
    14	
    15	For each of their roles, a user can see their current work and their past (completed) work, and can view a status timeline — the ordered history of status changes — for every item of work they are responsible for.
    16	
    17	A user may have more than one assigned role:
    18	
    19	- The user must explicitly select the role they are currently working under, and permissions and work views must use that selected role.
    20	- Switching role context must not add or remove any roles from the account.
    21	
    22	### Requester
    23	
    24	A requester should be able to:
    25	
    26	- Check whether a location and sample can be serviced before creating a request.
    27	- Create a home or clinic collection request.
    28	- Follow the sample’s current status, location, route and history.
    29	- See only requests that belong to them.
    30	
    31	The serviceability check must be a dry run. It must not create a request, sample, journey, assignment or capacity reservation.
    32	
    33	### Certified collection professional
    34	
    35	A certified collection professional should be able to:
    36	
    37	- View collection work for which they are qualified.
    38	- Accept or decline an offered collection assignment.
    39	- Record that a sample was collected and sealed.
    40	- Record their current location.
    41	- Hand off and confirm the transfer of the sealed sample to a relay courier or facility.
    42	
    43	### Relay courier
    44	
    45	A relay courier should be able to:
    46	
    47	- View delivery work assigned to them.
    48	- Accept or decline an offered transport assignment.
    49	- See only the details needed for their assigned leg.
    50	- Record location and progress updates.
    51	- Confirm pickup and handoff with the other party.
    52	
    53	### Node handler
    54	
    55	A node handler should be able to:
    56	
    57	- Accept or decline an offered node assignment.
    58	- Manage samples arriving at and leaving a collection centre or hub.
    59	- Register a sample that was already collected and sealed before entering the system.
    60	- Confirm incoming and outgoing handoffs.
    61	- View and configure regular and cooled capacity at the node they are assigned to.
    62	
    63	### Laboratory intake operator
    64	
    65	A laboratory intake operator should be able to:
    66	
    67	- Accept or decline an offered laboratory assignment.
    68	- View expected samples and configure regular and cooled capacity at the laboratory they are assigned to.
    69	- Confirm that a sample was received.
    70	- Record an exception when a sample cannot be accepted normally.
    71	
    72	### Dispatcher
    73	
    74	A dispatcher should be able to:
    75	
    76	- Monitor samples, workers, collection nodes, laboratories, routes and exceptions.
    77	- See the current holder of each sample and whether its latest location is stale.
    78	- View the full journey, including collection and individual transport legs.
    79	- Change, split, merge, cancel or reroute unfinished work.
    80	- Replan unfinished work when a worker, node, route, laboratory or capacity pool becomes unavailable.
    81	- Search the complete audit history of a request or sample.
    82	
    83	Completed work and confirmed custody must not be rewritten during replanning.
    84	
    85	### Administrator
    86	
    87	An administrator may also do everything a dispatcher can do.
    88	
    89	In addition, only an administrator can:
    90	
    91	- Manage users, roles and professional certifications, including which node or laboratory a node handler or laboratory intake operator is assigned to.
    92	- Create and update collection nodes and laboratories.
    93	- Create and update sample types and their handling attributes.
    94	- Activate or deactivate a location, an individual function it provides, or a connection, without restarting the application.
    95	- Configure service coverage, travel times, handling times and laboratory capabilities.
    96	- Configure regular and cooled capacity for any node, laboratory, or transport connection.
    97	
    98	## Collection requests
    99	
   100	A collection request records where and when a sample can be collected and when it must reach the laboratory:
   101	
   102	- **Origin** — a patient’s home, a clinic, or a network node.
   103	- **Sample type** — see Sample types below.
   104	- **Collection window** — the earliest and latest time at which the sample may be collected. Collection must take place inside this window.
   105	- **Delivery deadline** — the time by which the sample must be received at the laboratory.
   106	
   107	The collection window and the delivery deadline are separate constraints: the window governs when pickup may happen, the deadline governs when laboratory receipt must happen. A plan is valid only when collection takes place within the collection window and the sample can still reach an accepting laboratory before its delivery deadline.
   108	
   109	## Pre-sealed samples
   110	
   111	A certified collection professional, relay courier, node handler, or laboratory intake operator may register a sample that was already collected and sealed before entering the system — the person registering it must be the one who currently holds it.
   112	
   113	- Its origin must be a clinic or a network node — not a home.
   114	- The system should create only the transport legs needed from the point of registration onward.
   115	
   116	## Sample types
   117	
   118	Every sample has a type that determines its handling rules, and those rules apply for the whole journey, from collection through laboratory receipt. The system must have at least the following named types available by default: Amber, Indigo, Frost, Pulse. Each of the four requires a qualified collector — only a certified collection professional holding the matching qualification may collect it.
   119	
   120	- **Amber** — standard handling.

Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/INSTRUCTION.md:
   121	- **Indigo** — must not share a container with an Amber sample.
   122	- **Frost** — requires cooled storage and transport throughout its entire journey.
   123	- **Pulse** — time-critical; it must not wait to be combined into a consolidation batch and must be routed without batching delay.
   124	
   125	These named rules are in addition to the generic handling attributes (container, temperature range, qualified-collector requirement, and incompatibilities).
   126	
   127	## Network locations
   128	
   129	The transport network is made up of locations. A single location — a node — may act as a collection point, a transfer point, a hub, a laboratory, or any combination of these (for example, a hub that also acts as a laboratory).
   130	
   131	- **Collection point** — where samples are collected from or enter the network. Serviceability is measured from active collection points.
   132	- **Transfer point / hub** — where a sample changes custody or moves between transport legs.
   133	- **Laboratory** — where a sample is received and its journey completes; a laboratory accepts specific sample types.
   134	
   135	A location may perform several of these functions at the same time.
   136	
   137	## Journey and assignment rules
   138	
   139	The system must support direct, multi-stop and batched journeys.
   140	
   141	A journey may contain several separately assigned transport legs. For example:
   142	
   143	1. Patient’s home to a local collection centre
   144	2. Local collection centre to a hub
   145	3. Hub to the laboratory
   146	
   147	Each movement between two locations is a separate assignment and may be handled by a different worker.
   148	
   149	Collection must happen before transport. Pickup must happen before delivery, and responsibility for the sample must be transferred through a confirmed handoff before the next person continues the journey.
   150	
   151	Work should be assigned fairly among eligible and available workers:
   152	
   153	- Consider each worker’s current workload and recent assignments.
   154	- Offer an assignment to one worker at a time.
   155	- A node or laboratory assignment may only be offered to a worker assigned to that specific node or laboratory
   156	- A worker who declines an assignment may still receive suitable work later.
   157	- An offer that receives no response within a reasonable time must be treated as declined and re-offered to the next eligible worker.
   158	- If no qualified worker is ever available for an assignment that requires one, and none becomes available within a reasonable time, the sample must be flagged as an exception for that specific reason — distinguishable from a missed delivery deadline.
   159	- Repeated declines may lower a worker’s priority for future offers for a limited time, but must never permanently exclude them from future work.
   160	- An assignment cannot be accepted by someone other than the worker to whom it was offered.
   161	
   162	## Serviceability
   163	
   164	A request is serviceable only when:
   165	
   166	- Its origin is within 5 km of an active collection node.
   167	- The sample can reach an active laboratory that accepts its sample type.
   168	- A valid route is available.
   169	- Required regular or cooled capacity is available.
   170	- All handling and container rules can be satisfied.
   171	- The sample can reach the laboratory before its deadline.
   172	
   173	Serviceability depends only on the structure of the network — active nodes, routes, laboratory capabilities, and capacity. The temporary availability of a particular staff member or vehicle at a given moment must not change the serviceable region.
   174	
   175	A requester should be able to perform this check independently of creating a request.
   176	
   177	The network's serviceability calculation must be published as one complete serviceability-calculation version at a time. While a new serviceability-calculation version is being computed, the system must keep serving the previous complete serviceability-calculation version, so that no request is checked against a partial or in-progress calculation.
   178	
   179	A batch is valid only when:
   180	
   181	- The assigned worker is eligible.
   182	- The samples are allowed to travel together.
   183	- Their container and temperature requirements are compatible.
   184	- Enough capacity is available.
   185	- Stops are in the correct order.
   186	- Every sample can still meet its deadline.
   187	
   188	Whenever a route or batch changes, validate every affected leg and capacity reservation against these same criteria. If that validation fails, reject the change and keep the current plan in place.
   189	
   190	## Capacity
   191	
   192	Collection nodes, laboratories and transport connections may have separate regular and cooled capacity, tracked as configured, reserved, and available units for both regular and cooled storage or transport.
   193	
   194	Capacity must be reserved when a journey is created and released when it is no longer required. The system must never overbook a capacity pool.
   195	
   196	## Chain of custody
   197	
   198	Every sealed sample must have exactly one current holder at all times.
   199	
   200	A handoff requires confirmation from both the sender and receiver. Until both sides confirm, the sender remains responsible for the sample. The receiver becomes the current holder only after the handoff is complete. Repeated or delayed handoff confirmations must not create duplicate transfers of custody. All custody changes must appear in the sample’s lifecycle and audit history. 
   201	
   202	At any point while holding custody of a sample, a certified collection professional, relay courier, node handler, or laboratory intake operator may record a handling checkpoint - the container type and temperature they currently observe. If the observed container or temperature falls outside the sample's required range, the sample must be marked as an exception.
   203	
   204	## Disruptions and replanning
   205	
   206	When part of a journey becomes unavailable:
   207	
   208	- Keep the current sample holder unchanged.
   209	- Preserve completed assignments, stops and handoffs.
   210	- Replan only unfinished work.
   211	- Allow only one active replacement plan.
   212	- Recheck worker eligibility, compatibility, capacity and deadlines.
   213	- Mark the sample as expired if no valid route can meet its deadline.
   214	
   215	Plan changes must use journey plan-version checks so that outdated updates cannot overwrite newer ones for that journey.
   216	
   217	## Tracking and audit
   218	
   219	Show routes, nodes, laboratories, and the current locations of certified collection professionals and relay couriers on a live map.
   220	
   221	For each sample, show:
   222	
   223	- Its current or last known location
   224	- Current custodian
   225	- Route progress
   226	- The time of its last update
   227	- Whether that location is stale
   228	
   229	Keep searchable audit logs covering sign-ins, permission checks, offers, collection, sealing, custody, routes, nodes, capacity, overrides, exceptions, and completion. Each audit record must capture the user, their role, the action taken, the affected item, the time, the outcome, and the relevant changes.
   230	
   231	## Technical requirements
   232	
   233	- Backend: Go
   234	- Frontend: React with TypeScript
   235	- Maps: MapLibre GL JS with the supplied local PMTiles map assets
   236	
   237	Document how to build, run, reset and test the complete application.
   238	
   239	The environment provides PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis. Use the services that are appropriate for your design. You are not required to use every available datastore only because it is present. Application state that is expected to be durable must survive an ordinary application restart.

package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"lab-transport/internal/auth"
	"lab-transport/internal/config"
	"lab-transport/internal/db"
	"lab-transport/internal/handlers"
	"lab-transport/internal/routing"
	"lab-transport/internal/services"
)

func main() {
	cfg := config.LoadConfig()

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	database, err := db.Connect(ctx, cfg.DatabaseURL)
	cancel()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Failed to connect to database: %v", err)
	}
	defer database.Close()

	// Initialize Services
	authSvc := auth.NewAuthService(database)
	auditSvc := services.NewAuditService(database)
	eventSvc := services.NewEventService(database)
	userSvc := services.NewUserService(database, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	rEngine := routing.NewServiceabilityEngine(database)
	fairness := services.NewFairnessEngine(database, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	locSvc := services.NewLocationService(database, rEngine, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	sampleSvc := services.NewSampleService(database, rEngine, fairness, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	journeySvc := services.NewJourneyService(database, rEngine, fairness, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	opSvc := services.NewOperationsService(database, rEngine)

	// Compute initial snapshot
	ctxSnap, cancelSnap := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	_ = rEngine.RecomputeSnapshot(ctxSnap)
	cancelSnap()

	// Ensure Initial Admin
	adminUser := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	adminPass := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
	if adminUser == "" {
		adminUser = "admin"
	}
	if adminPass == "" {
		adminPass = "Admin123!"
	}
	ctxAdmin, cancelAdmin := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	_ = authSvc.EnsureInitialAdmin(ctxAdmin, adminUser, adminPass)
	cancelAdmin()

	apiHandler := handlers.NewAPIHandler(
		database, authSvc, auditSvc, eventSvc, userSvc, locSvc, sampleSvc, journeySvc, opSvc, rEngine, fairness,
	)

	r := mux.NewRouter()

	// Global CORS middleware
	r.Use(corsMiddleware)

	// Readiness check (no auth)
	r.HandleFunc("/ready", apiHandler.ReadyHandler).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/ready", apiHandler.ReadyHandler).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")

	// Auth & Serviceability Check (no session auth required)
	r.HandleFunc("/api/authenticate-user", apiHandler.AuthenticateUser).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/check-serviceability", apiHandler.CheckServiceability).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/read-serviceability-snapshot", apiHandler.ReadServiceabilitySnapshot).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/list-sample-types", apiHandler.ListSampleTypes).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/get-sample-type/{sampleTypeId}", apiHandler.GetSampleType).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/list-locations", apiHandler.ListLocations).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/get-location/{locationId}", apiHandler.GetLocation).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/list-connections", apiHandler.ListConnections).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/get-connection/{connectionId}", apiHandler.GetConnection).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/events", apiHandler.EventsSSE).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")

	// Protected routes subrouter
	api := r.PathPrefix("/api").Subrouter()
	api.Use(authSvc.AuthMiddleware)

	api.HandleFunc("/select-active-role", apiHandler.SelectActiveRole).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/read-user/{userId}", apiHandler.ReadUser).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/create-user", apiHandler.CreateUser).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-user-access", apiHandler.UpdateUserAccess).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-worker-availability", apiHandler.SetWorkerAvailability).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/record-worker-location", apiHandler.RecordWorkerLocation).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/create-location", apiHandler.CreateLocation).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-location", apiHandler.UpdateLocation).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-location-status", apiHandler.SetLocationStatus).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-location-function-status", apiHandler.SetLocationFunctionStatus).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/create-connection", apiHandler.CreateConnection).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-connection-status", apiHandler.SetConnectionStatus).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/configure-capacity", apiHandler.ConfigureCapacity).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/configure-laboratory-acceptance", apiHandler.ConfigureLaboratoryAcceptance).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/create-sample-type", apiHandler.CreateSampleType).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-sample-type", apiHandler.UpdateSampleType).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/create-collection-request", apiHandler.CreateCollectionRequest).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/ingest-presealed-sample", apiHandler.IngestPresealedSample).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/collect-and-seal-sample", apiHandler.CollectAndSealSample).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/initiate-handoff", apiHandler.InitiateHandoff).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/confirm-handoff", apiHandler.ConfirmHandoff).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/record-handling-checkpoint", apiHandler.RecordHandlingCheckpoint).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/confirm-laboratory-receipt", apiHandler.ConfirmLaboratoryReceipt).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/record-laboratory-exception", apiHandler.RecordLaboratoryException).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/read-sample-lifecycle", apiHandler.ReadSampleLifecycle).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/read-journey-plan", apiHandler.ReadJourneyPlan).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/accept-assignment", apiHandler.AcceptAssignment).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/decline-assignment", apiHandler.DeclineAssignment).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-assignment-progress", apiHandler.UpdateAssignmentProgress).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/edit-active-plan", apiHandler.EditActivePlan).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/reroute-journey", apiHandler.RerouteJourney).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/cancel-journey", apiHandler.CancelJourney).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/merge-journeys", apiHandler.MergeJourneys).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/split-journey", apiHandler.SplitJourney).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/report-disruption", apiHandler.ReportDisruption).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/list-role-work", apiHandler.ListRoleWork).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/read-operations-state", apiHandler.ReadOperationsState).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/search-audit-trail", apiHandler.SearchAuditTrail).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	// Map assets handler (/map-assets/*)
	mapAssetsDir := "/map-assets"
	if _, err := os.Stat(mapAssetsDir); err == nil {
		r.PathPrefix("/map-assets/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/map-assets/", http.FileServer(http.Dir(mapAssetsDir))))
	}

	// Frontend SPA static file server
	frontendDist := "/workspace/frontend/dist"
	r.PathPrefix("/").Handler(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(req.URL.Path, "/api") || req.URL.Path == "/ready" || strings.HasPrefix(req.URL.Path, "/map-assets") {
			http.NotFound(w, req)
			return
		}

		path := filepath.Join(frontendDist, filepath.Clean(req.URL.Path))
		if stat, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil && !stat.IsDir() {
			http.ServeFile(w, req, path)
			return
		}
		// Fallback to index.html for SPA client-side routing
		http.ServeFile(w, req, filepath.Join(frontendDist, "index.html"))
	}))

	port := os.Getenv("PORT")
	if port == "" {
		port = "8080"
	}
	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:         ":" + port,
		Handler:      r,
		ReadTimeout:  30 * time.Second,
		WriteTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
	}

	go func() {
		log.Printf("Server listening on http://127.0.0.1:%s", port)
		if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			log.Fatalf("HTTP server error: %v", err)
		}
	}()

	// Graceful shutdown
	quit := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(quit, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	<-quit

	log.Println("Shutting down server gracefully...")
	ctxShut, cancelShut := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancelShut()
	_ = server.Shutdown(ctxShut)
	log.Println("Server exited")
}

func corsMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Authorization, X-Requested-With, Idempotency-Key")

		if r.Method == "OPTIONS" {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			return
		}

		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

	api.HandleFunc("/select-active-role", apiHandler.SelectActiveRole).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

			http.NotFound(w, req)
			return
		}

		path := filepath.Join(frontendDist, filepath.Clean(req.URL.Path))
		if stat, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil && !stat.IsDir() {
			http.ServeFile(w, req, path)
			return
		}
		// Fallback to index.html for SPA client-side routing
		http.ServeFile(w, req, filepath.Join(frontendDist, "index.html"))
	}))

	port := os.Getenv("PORT")
	if port == "" {
		port = "8080"
	}
	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:         ":" + port,
		Handler:      r,
		ReadTimeout:  30 * time.Second,
		WriteTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
	}

	go func() {
		log.Printf("Server listening on http://127.0.0.1:%s", port)
		if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			log.Fatalf("HTTP server error: %v", err)
		}
	}()

	// Graceful shutdown
	quit := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(quit, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	<-quit

	log.Println("Shutting down server gracefully...")
	ctxShut, cancelShut := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancelShut()
	_ = server.Shutdown(ctxShut)
	log.Println("Server exited")
}

func corsMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Authorization, X-Requested-With, Idempotency-Key")

		if r.Method == "OPTIONS" {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			return
		}

		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

[?2004lpackage main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"path/filepath"

	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"lab-transport/internal/auth"
	"lab-transport/internal/config"
	"lab-transport/internal/db"
	"lab-transport/internal/handlers"
	"lab-transport/internal/routing"
	"lab-transport/internal/services"
)

func main() {
	cfg := config.LoadConfig()

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	database, err := db.Connect(ctx, cfg.DatabaseURL)
	cancel()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Failed to connect to database: %v", err)
	}
	defer database.Close()

	// Initialize Services
	authSvc := auth.NewAuthService(database)
	auditSvc := services.NewAuditService(database)
	eventSvc := services.NewEventService(database)
	userSvc := services.NewUserService(database, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	rEngine := routing.NewServiceabilityEngine(database)
	fairness := services.NewFairnessEngine(database, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	locSvc := services.NewLocationService(database, rEngine, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	sampleSvc := services.NewSampleService(database, rEngine, fairness, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	journeySvc := services.NewJourneyService(database, rEngine, fairness, auditSvc, eventSvc)
	opSvc := services.NewOperationsService(database, rEngine)

	// Compute initial snapshot
	ctxSnap, cancelSnap := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	_ = rEngine.RecomputeSnapshot(ctxSnap)
	cancelSnap()

	// Ensure Initial Admin
	adminUser := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	adminPass := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
	if adminUser == "" {
		adminUser = "admin"
	}
	if adminPass == "" {
		adminPass = "Admin123!"
	}
	ctxAdmin, cancelAdmin := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	_ = authSvc.EnsureInitialAdmin(ctxAdmin, adminUser, adminPass)
	cancelAdmin()

	apiHandler := handlers.NewAPIHandler(
		database, authSvc, auditSvc, eventSvc, userSvc, locSvc, sampleSvc, journeySvc, opSvc, rEngine, fairness,
	)

	r := mux.NewRouter()

	// Global CORS middleware
	r.Use(corsMiddleware)

	// Readiness check (no auth)
	r.HandleFunc("/ready", apiHandler.ReadyHandler).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/ready", apiHandler.ReadyHandler).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")

	// Auth & Serviceability Check (no session auth required)
	r.HandleFunc("/api/authenticate-user", apiHandler.AuthenticateUser).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/check-serviceability", apiHandler.CheckServiceability).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/read-serviceability-snapshot", apiHandler.ReadServiceabilitySnapshot).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/list-sample-types", apiHandler.ListSampleTypes).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/get-sample-type/{sampleTypeId}", apiHandler.GetSampleType).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/list-locations", apiHandler.ListLocations).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/get-location/{locationId}", apiHandler.GetLocation).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/list-connections", apiHandler.ListConnections).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/get-connection/{connectionId}", apiHandler.GetConnection).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	r.HandleFunc("/api/events", apiHandler.EventsSSE).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")

	// Protected routes subrouter
	api := r.PathPrefix("/api").Subrouter()
	api.Use(authSvc.AuthMiddleware)

	api.HandleFunc("/select-active-role", apiHandler.SelectActiveRole).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/read-user/{userId}", apiHandler.ReadUser).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/create-user", apiHandler.CreateUser).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-user-access", apiHandler.UpdateUserAccess).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-worker-availability", apiHandler.SetWorkerAvailability).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/record-worker-location", apiHandler.RecordWorkerLocation).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/create-location", apiHandler.CreateLocation).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-location", apiHandler.UpdateLocation).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-location-status", apiHandler.SetLocationStatus).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-location-function-status", apiHandler.SetLocationFunctionStatus).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/create-connection", apiHandler.CreateConnection).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/set-connection-status", apiHandler.SetConnectionStatus).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/configure-capacity", apiHandler.ConfigureCapacity).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/configure-laboratory-acceptance", apiHandler.ConfigureLaboratoryAcceptance).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/create-sample-type", apiHandler.CreateSampleType).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-sample-type", apiHandler.UpdateSampleType).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/create-collection-request", apiHandler.CreateCollectionRequest).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/ingest-presealed-sample", apiHandler.IngestPresealedSample).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/collect-and-seal-sample", apiHandler.CollectAndSealSample).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/initiate-handoff", apiHandler.InitiateHandoff).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/confirm-handoff", apiHandler.ConfirmHandoff).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/record-handling-checkpoint", apiHandler.RecordHandlingCheckpoint).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/confirm-laboratory-receipt", apiHandler.ConfirmLaboratoryReceipt).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/record-laboratory-exception", apiHandler.RecordLaboratoryException).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/read-sample-lifecycle", apiHandler.ReadSampleLifecycle).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/read-sample-state/{sampleId}", apiHandler.ReadSampleState).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/ui/bootstrap", apiHandler.ReadUIBootstrap).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/read-journey-plan", apiHandler.ReadJourneyPlan).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/accept-assignment", apiHandler.AcceptAssignment).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/decline-assignment", apiHandler.DeclineAssignment).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/update-assignment-progress", apiHandler.UpdateAssignmentProgress).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/edit-active-plan", apiHandler.EditActivePlan).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/reroute-journey", apiHandler.RerouteJourney).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/cancel-journey", apiHandler.CancelJourney).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/merge-journeys", apiHandler.MergeJourneys).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/split-journey", apiHandler.SplitJourney).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/report-disruption", apiHandler.ReportDisruption).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/list-role-work", apiHandler.ListRoleWork).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	api.HandleFunc("/read-operations-state", apiHandler.ReadOperationsState).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	api.HandleFunc("/search-audit-trail", apiHandler.SearchAuditTrail).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")

	// Map assets handler (/map-assets/*)
	mapAssetsDir := "/opt/arena/map-assets"
	if _, err := os.Stat(mapAssetsDir); err != nil {
		mapAssetsDir = "/map-assets"
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(mapAssetsDir); err == nil {
		r.PathPrefix("/map-assets/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/map-assets/", http.FileServer(http.Dir(mapAssetsDir))))
	}

	// Frontend SPA static file server
	frontendDist := "/workspace/frontend/dist"
	r.PathPrefix("/").Handler(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(req.URL.Path, "/api") || req.URL.Path == "/ready" || strings.HasPrefix(req.URL.Path, "/map-assets") {
			http.NotFound(w, req)
			return
		}

		path := filepath.Join(frontendDist, filepath.Clean(req.URL.Path))
		if stat, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil && !stat.IsDir() {
			http.ServeFile(w, req, path)
			return
		}
		// Fallback to index.html for SPA client-side routing
		http.ServeFile(w, req, filepath.Join(frontendDist, "index.html"))
	}))

	port := os.Getenv("PORT")
	if port == "" {
		port = "8080"
	}
	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:         ":" + port,
		Handler:      r,
		ReadTimeout:  30 * time.Second,
		WriteTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
	}

	go func() {
		log.Printf("Server listening on http://127.0.0.1:%s", port)
		if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			log.Fatalf("HTTP server error: %v", err)
		}
	}()

	// Graceful shutdown
	quit := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(quit, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	<-quit

	log.Println("Shutting down server gracefully...")
	ctxShut, cancelShut := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancelShut()
	_ = server.Shutdown(ctxShut)
	log.Println("Server exited")
}

func corsMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Authorization, X-Requested-With, Idempotency-Key")

		if r.Method == "OPTIONS" {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			return
		}

		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

[?2004l-- Schema for Lab Transport and Delivery System

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    username VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(255),
    full_name VARCHAR(255),
    phone VARCHAR(50),
    roles JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    qualifications JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    certifications JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    assigned_location_id UUID,
    available BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
    token VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    active_role VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sample_types (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    qualified_collector_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    required_qualification VARCHAR(255),
    container_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    temperature_min_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    temperature_max_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    incompatible_sample_types JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    requires_cooled_route BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    batching_allowed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    coverage_km DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 5.0,
    handling_minutes INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    functions JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"collection_point": false, "transfer_point": false, "hub": false, "laboratory": false}',
    capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
    reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    cooled_capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 50,
    cooled_reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    accepted_sample_type_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS connections (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    from_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    to_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    travel_minutes INT NOT NULL,
    cost_units DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    cooled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 50,
    reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    cooled_capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 25,
    cooled_reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS requests (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    requester_id UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    origin_lat DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    origin_lng DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    origin_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'home',
    origin_node_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    delivery_deadline TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    earliest_collection_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    latest_collection_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    sample_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sample_types(id),
    container_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    temperature_min_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    temperature_max_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    incompatible_sample_types JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    serviceability VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    serviceability_reason VARCHAR(255),
    target_laboratory_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS samples (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    request_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    requester_id UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    sample_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sample_types(id),
    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'requested',
    sealed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    sealed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    current_holder_id UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    active_journey_id UUID,
    target_laboratory_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    received_laboratory_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    received_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    exception_details JSONB,
    latest_lat DOUBLE PRECISION,
    latest_lng DOUBLE PRECISION,
    location_recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journeys (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    parent_journey_id UUID REFERENCES journeys(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    plan_version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    route_mode VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'direct',
    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    estimated_delivery_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    total_cost_units DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    capacity_used INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    capacity_available INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    replan_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_required',
    sample_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journey_stops (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    journey_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journeys(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    stop_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    sequence INT NOT NULL,
    estimated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    dwell_minutes INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assignments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    journey_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journeys(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sample_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES samples(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    kind VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    sequence INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'offered',
    worker_id UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    from_location_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    to_location_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    node_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    laboratory_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    offer_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    declined_by UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    declined_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS handoffs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    sample_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES samples(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    from_assignment_id UUID REFERENCES assignments(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    to_assignment_id UUID REFERENCES assignments(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    sender_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    receiver_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    sender_confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    sender_confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    receiver_confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    receiver_confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS worker_locations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    assignment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    worker_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    sequence INT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS checkpoints (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    sample_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES samples(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    assignment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    worker_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    location_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    container_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    observed_temperature_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    compliant BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_entries (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    audit_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    actor_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    role VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    actor_role VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    action VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    entity_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    entity_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    success BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    details JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS realtime_events (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    entity_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    entity_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_keys (
    key VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
    operation VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    request_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    response_status INT NOT NULL,
    response_body JSONB NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS serviceability_snapshots (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS worker_penalties (

import sys
import time
import requests

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
API_URL = f"{BASE_URL}/api"

def run_tests():
    print("=== STARTING INTEGRATION TESTS ===")

    # 1. Readiness
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/ready")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Ready check failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    assert r.json().get("status") == "ready", f"Unexpected ready response: {r.json()}"
    print("✓ Readiness check passed")

    # 2. Frontend & Map Assets
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Frontend index failed: {r.status_code}"
    assert "<html" in r.text.lower() or "<!doctype html>" in r.text.lower(), "Frontend HTML not served"
    print("✓ Frontend root HTML served")

    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/map-assets/style.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Map style.json failed: {r.status_code}"
    assert "version" in r.json(), "Invalid style.json"
    print("✓ Map assets style.json served")

    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/map-assets/map.pmtiles", headers={"Range": "bytes=0-511"})
    assert r.status_code in [200, 206], f"PMTiles range request failed: {r.status_code}"
    print("✓ PMTiles binary header served")

    # 3. Authenticate initial admin
    r = requests.post(f"{API_URL}/authenticate-user", json={"username": "admin", "password": "Admin123!"})
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Login failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    login_data = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    token = login_data["sessionToken"]
    admin_id = login_data["userId"]
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    print("✓ Initial admin authenticated:", admin_id)

    # 4. Bootstrap UI
    r = requests.get(f"{API_URL}/ui/bootstrap", headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Bootstrap failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    boot_data = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    assert "user" in boot_data, "No user in bootstrap"
    assert "operations" in boot_data, "No operations in bootstrap"
    print("✓ UI Bootstrap succeeded")

    # 5. List sample types and locations
    r = requests.get(f"{API_URL}/list-sample-types", headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"List sample types failed: {r.status_code}"
    types = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    amber_type = next((t for t in types if t.get("name") == "Amber"), None)
    assert amber_type is not None, "Amber sample type missing"
    amber_id = amber_type.get("id") or amber_type.get("sampleTypeId")
    print("✓ Sample types listed. Amber ID:", amber_id)

    r = requests.get(f"{API_URL}/list-locations", headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"List locations failed: {r.status_code}"
    locations = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    assert len(locations) >= 1, "No locations returned"
    print(f"✓ Locations listed: {len(locations)} found")

    # 6. Serviceability check (dry run)
    serv_payload = {
        "origin": {"latitude": 12.9750, "longitude": 77.6000},
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": amber_id,
        "requestedAt": "2026-09-17T21:00:00Z",
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-09-17T23:00:00Z",
        "earliestCollectionAt": "2026-09-17T21:10:00Z",
        "latestCollectionAt": "2026-09-17T21:40:00Z"
    }

        print("✓ Handling checkpoint recorded")

    presealed_id = presealed_sample.get("id") or presealed_sample.get("sampleId")
    print("✓ Ingested pre-sealed sample successfully. Sample ID:", presealed_id)

import sys
import time
import requests

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
API_URL = f"{BASE_URL}/api"

def run_tests():
    print("=== STARTING INTEGRATION TESTS ===")

    # 1. Readiness
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/ready")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Ready check failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    assert r.json().get("status") == "ready", f"Unexpected ready response: {r.json()}"
    print("✓ Readiness check passed")

    # 2. Frontend & Map Assets
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Frontend index failed: {r.status_code}"
    assert "<html" in r.text.lower() or "<!doctype html>" in r.text.lower(), "Frontend HTML not served"
    print("✓ Frontend root HTML served")

    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/map-assets/style.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Map style.json failed: {r.status_code}"
    assert "version" in r.json(), "Invalid style.json"
    print("✓ Map assets style.json served")

    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/map-assets/bangalore.pmtiles", headers={"Range": "bytes=0-511"})
    assert r.status_code in [200, 206], f"PMTiles range request failed: {r.status_code}"
    print("✓ PMTiles binary header served")

    # 3. Authenticate initial admin
    r = requests.post(f"{API_URL}/authenticate-user", json={"username": "admin", "password": "Admin123!"})
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Login failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    login_data = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    token = login_data["sessionToken"]
    admin_id = login_data["userId"]
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    print("✓ Initial admin authenticated:", admin_id)

    # 4. Bootstrap UI
    r = requests.get(f"{API_URL}/ui/bootstrap", headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Bootstrap failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    boot_data = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    assert "user" in boot_data, "No user in bootstrap"
    assert "operations" in boot_data, "No operations in bootstrap"
    print("✓ UI Bootstrap succeeded")

    # 5. List sample types and locations
    r = requests.get(f"{API_URL}/list-sample-types", headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"List sample types failed: {r.status_code}"
    types = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    amber_type = next((t for t in types if t.get("name") == "Amber"), None)
    assert amber_type is not None, "Amber sample type missing"
    amber_id = amber_type.get("id") or amber_type.get("sampleTypeId")
    print("✓ Sample types listed. Amber ID:", amber_id)

    r = requests.get(f"{API_URL}/list-locations", headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"List locations failed: {r.status_code}"
    locations = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    assert len(locations) >= 1, "No locations returned"
    print(f"✓ Locations listed: {len(locations)} found")

    # 6. Serviceability check (dry run)
    serv_payload = {
        "origin": {"latitude": 12.9750, "longitude": 77.6000},
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": amber_id,
        "requestedAt": "2026-09-17T21:00:00Z",
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-09-17T23:00:00Z",
        "earliestCollectionAt": "2026-09-17T21:10:00Z",
        "latestCollectionAt": "2026-09-17T21:40:00Z"
    }
    r = requests.post(f"{API_URL}/check-serviceability", json=serv_payload, headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Check serviceability failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    serv_res = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    assert serv_res.get("serviceable") is True, f"Expected serviceable: {serv_res}"
    print("✓ Serviceability dry run check passed:", serv_res.get("serviceable"))

    # 7. Create collection request as Requester
    req_payload = {
        "origin": {"latitude": 12.9750, "longitude": 77.6000},
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": amber_id,
        "containerType": "ambient_insulated_box",
        "temperatureMinC": 15.0,
        "temperatureMaxC": 25.0,
        "requestedAt": "2026-09-17T21:00:00Z",
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-09-17T23:00:00Z",
        "earliestCollectionAt": "2026-09-17T21:10:00Z",
        "latestCollectionAt": "2026-09-17T21:40:00Z",
        "idempotencyKey": f"test_req_{int(time.time())}"
    }
    r = requests.post(f"{API_URL}/create-collection-request", json=req_payload, headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code in [200, 201], f"Create collection request failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    created_sample = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    sample_id = created_sample.get("id") or created_sample.get("sampleId")
    assert sample_id, f"Sample ID missing in creation response: {created_sample}"
    print("✓ Created collection request successfully. Sample ID:", sample_id)

    # 8. List role work as collection_professional
    r = requests.post(f"{API_URL}/select-active-role", json={"role": "collection_professional"}, headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Select role collection_professional failed: {r.status_code}"
    print("✓ Switched role to collection_professional")

    r = requests.post(f"{API_URL}/list-role-work", json={"role": "collection_professional"}, headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"List role work failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    work_resp = r.json()
    print("Work response:", work_resp)
    work_list = work_resp.get("data", work_resp)
    if isinstance(work_list, dict) and "assignments" in work_list:
        work_list = work_list["assignments"]
    elif isinstance(work_list, dict) and "work" in work_list:

import sys
import time
import requests

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
API_URL = f"{BASE_URL}/api"

def run_tests():
    print("=== STARTING INTEGRATION TESTS ===")

    # 1. Readiness
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/ready")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Ready check failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    assert r.json().get("status") == "ready", f"Unexpected ready response: {r.json()}"
    print("✓ Readiness check passed")

    # 2. Frontend & Map Assets
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Frontend index failed: {r.status_code}"
    assert "<html" in r.text.lower() or "<!doctype html>" in r.text.lower(), "Frontend HTML not served"
    print("✓ Frontend root HTML served")

    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/map-assets/style.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Map style.json failed: {r.status_code}"
    assert "version" in r.json(), "Invalid style.json"
    print("✓ Map assets style.json served")

    r = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/map-assets/bangalore.pmtiles", headers={"Range": "bytes=0-511"})
    assert r.status_code in [200, 206], f"PMTiles range request failed: {r.status_code}"
    print("✓ PMTiles binary header served")

    # 3. Authenticate initial admin
    r = requests.post(f"{API_URL}/authenticate-user", json={"username": "admin", "password": "Admin123!"})
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Login failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    login_data = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    token = login_data["sessionToken"]
    admin_id = login_data["userId"]
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    print("✓ Initial admin authenticated:", admin_id)

    # 4. Bootstrap UI
    r = requests.get(f"{API_URL}/ui/bootstrap", headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Bootstrap failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    boot_data = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    assert "user" in boot_data, "No user in bootstrap"
    assert "operations" in boot_data, "No operations in bootstrap"
    print("✓ UI Bootstrap succeeded")

    # 5. List sample types and locations
    r = requests.get(f"{API_URL}/list-sample-types", headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"List sample types failed: {r.status_code}"
    types = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    amber_type = next((t for t in types if t.get("name") == "Amber"), None)
    assert amber_type is not None, "Amber sample type missing"
    amber_id = amber_type.get("id") or amber_type.get("sampleTypeId")
    print("✓ Sample types listed. Amber ID:", amber_id)

    r = requests.get(f"{API_URL}/list-locations", headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"List locations failed: {r.status_code}"
    locations = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    assert len(locations) >= 1, "No locations returned"
    print(f"✓ Locations listed: {len(locations)} found")

    # 6. Serviceability check (dry run)
    serv_payload = {
        "origin": {"latitude": 12.9750, "longitude": 77.6000},
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": amber_id,
        "requestedAt": "2026-09-17T21:00:00Z",
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-09-17T23:00:00Z",
        "earliestCollectionAt": "2026-09-17T21:10:00Z",
        "latestCollectionAt": "2026-09-17T21:40:00Z"
    }
    r = requests.post(f"{API_URL}/check-serviceability", json=serv_payload, headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Check serviceability failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
    serv_res = r.json().get("data", r.json())
    assert serv_res.get("serviceable") is True, f"Expected serviceable: {serv_res}"
    print("✓ Serviceability dry run check passed:", serv_res.get("serviceable"))

    # 7. Create collection request as Requester
    req_payload = {
        "origin": {"latitude": 12.9750, "longitude": 77.6000},
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": amber_id,
        "containerType": "ambient_insulated_box",
        "temperatureMinC": 15.0,
        "temperatureMaxC": 25.0,
        "requestedAt": "2026-09-17T21:00:00Z",
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-09-17T23:00:00Z",
        "earliestCollectionAt": "2026-09-17T21:10:00Z",
        "latestCollectionAt": "2026-09-17T21:40:00Z",
